name: trados-studio
notes: Trados Studio is a WPF/.NET application and is one of the hardest targets under Wine. Licensing/activation may fail; test with a trial license first. Report every failure into the KnowledgeStore so recipes can be adapted.
steps: install winetricks verbs in the listed order
run the Trados Studio installer inside the bottle
record the outcome (evidence_status) in the knowledge store
